title: Transaction PIN
intro: You confirm high-value approvals and policy changes with this 6-digit PIN, on the web and in the LINE app. It is not your password.

status.notSetHint: Set a PIN before you approve a task that asks for it.
status.locked: Your PIN is locked until {time} after too many wrong tries in a row.
status.lockedUnlock: Set a new PIN below to unlock it now.
status.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# more wrong PIN locks it for a while.} other {# more wrong PINs lock it for a while.}}

rules.title: A PIN you can use
rules.notSame: not one digit six times, such as 000000
rules.notSequence: not digits going up or down, such as 123456 or 654321
rules.notCommon: not a PIN many people choose, such as 121212 or 147258
rules.private: Do not use a birthday or a number others know, and never tell anyone your PIN.

prove.title: Step 1 of 2: confirm it is you
prove.intro: Before you set or change the PIN, confirm who you are again with your password or the code from your authenticator app.
prove.methodHint: The authenticator code works only if your account has an authenticator app set up. If it has none, confirm with your password.
prove.code: The 6-digit code the app shows now

set.title: Step 2 of 2: set the new PIN

done.set: PIN set. Use it to confirm your next approval.
done.changed: PIN changed. Use the new PIN to confirm your next approval.

errors.PASSWORD_WRONG: The password is not right. Try again.
errors.CODE_FORMAT: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.CODE_WRONG: The code is not right or has expired. Enter the latest code from the app.
errors.TOTP_NOT_AVAILABLE: This account has no authenticator app set up. Confirm with your password instead.
errors.NOT_AVAILABLE: This way of confirming is not available. Ask your organization administrator.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries: confirming is paused for this account until {time}. Try again then.
errors.ALL_SAME: This PIN is one digit six times, which is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.SEQUENCE: This PIN is a run of digits, which is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.COMMON: Many people choose this PIN, so it is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.MISMATCH: The two PINs are not the same. Enter the same PIN twice.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain the PIN was set. Press the button again (it is not set twice) or reload the page to see the status.
errors.PROOF_EXPIRED: Your confirmation expired or was used already. Confirm it is you again, then set the PIN.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and repeat this.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this. Ask your organization administrator.
errors.BUSY: Something else of yours is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it keeps failing, give this reference to the BCS team.
errors.FAILED: It was not saved. Try again.
